title: Plus Size Rhinestone Embellished Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Plus Size Rhinestone Embellished Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress! This stunning piece features delicate rhinestone accents that catch the light beautifully, while the flowing chiffon fabric ensures a flattering fit. Perfect for celebrating love, this dress will make you feel confident and chic at any wedding!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
